expectations.text: B3: Identifies catastrophic/exponential backtracking and suggests Thompson NFA simulation (linear time)
expectations.evidence: Explicitly identifies it: 'This is catastrophic backtracking, and it's the classic signature: two quantifiers that can consume the same text, plus a failing match at the end.' Suggests the automata-based linear-time approach: 'Use a linear-time engine — RE2 (Go, C++), Rust's regex, or Hyperscan. They use automata instead of backtracking, so this input is instant'.
